# Security Policy

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please report security issues privately through GitHub's private vulnerability reporting: open the repository's **Security** tab and choose **Report a vulnerability**, or go straight to <https://github.com/rohal12/spindle-starter/security/advisories/new>.

Do not open a public issue or pull request for a vulnerability. Include what is affected (build scripts, development server, packaging for desktop, Android or JoiPlay, publishing, or the GitHub workflows), the steps to reproduce it, and the impact you expect.

The report stays private between you and the maintainers until a fix is released.

## Supported versions

Fixes go into `main` and the next release. Projects created from the starter can pick them up from the [changelog](https://github.com/rohal12/spindle-starter/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md).

## Related projects

Report issues in the story format, the compiler or the language server to their own repositories: [Spindle](https://github.com/rohal12/spindle), [twee-ts](https://github.com/rohal12/twee-ts) and [spindle-lsp](https://github.com/rohal12/spindle-lsp).
